The tower section comprises 5 floors each containing 13 apartments, offering a total of 65 residential units.

. A subtle grey Oakwood building standing tall in the flourishing neighborhood of Jumeirah Village Circle, Belgravia Square stands donning two L shaped blocks facing each other. The development offers Studio, 1BR and 2BR apartments with dedicated parking spaces for tenants. All the units within the tower are built in congruent color themes and patterns that are surely soothing to live in. This freehold development has been designed by some of the best designers and engineers in the business and Ellington Properties has again not compromised on its standards when it comes to combining elegance, class and value for money. The grey facade of the building provides the residents with an ultimate sense of serenity and a truly acoustic experience. All the primary interior appliances i.e. kitchen deck, sinks, faucets etc are of European high brands. All the residences are pre-fitted with high-end wood cabinets and walk-in closets and also securely pre-wired and covered to prevent exposure to kids. The residential development is surrounded by a larger than life beautifully landscaped garden providing a pretty view and access to those post-work me-time evening strolls.

, Jumeirah Islands Townhouses; more popularly known as (JIT) is a beautiful development of 4BR townhouses fenced by a gated community. The townhouses are designed, built, and furnished with a quintessential priority order to open space and a feel-good ambience around the house. Each house owns a dedicated and commodious garden area and veranda on the ground floor. The wooden doors in the houses instill a historic touch to the whole interior accompanied by crystal clear porcelain floors serenading the residents to a state of being in their comfort zone. Adorned by some of the best interior designers in the market, based on the residential community’s location, the interiors of the house come with an islandic vibes to them e.g. the steps and stairways are made using exotic aquatic stones. Thus, it would be safe to say that this residential project is all things aquatic and serenity.

Tourists, as well as residents, are also provided with the luxury to ala carte from St.Regis Dubai.

Golf Terrace consists of serviced hotel apartments and townhouses (townhouses located on the first two levels of the building). The project comprises of a studio, 1, 2, 3 and 4 serviced hotel apartments to be managed by NAIA, Damac’s hospitality division. The Golf Terrace offered a luxury furnished and serviced featuring satellite TV and telephone connection points, ceramic tiled floors throughout, fully equipped kitchen with cabinets. The bath is fitted with floor to wall ceramic tiles and standard sanitary ware, fittings, and accessories. The balcony opens to spectacular international Golf course view and serene greens. This the life that u want to live for, Strategically located in the western quarter of Dubailand, Golf Terrace at Akoya is within easy access to some of Dubai’s landmark locations, shopping districts, leisure spots, and entertainment options.

Vida Residence is an immaculate residential tower located on the globally famous Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard comprising of a whopping yet not so surprising (given its right opposite to the miracle i.e. Burj Khalifa), 57 storeys spread across 3 podium levels. There could be, in no way, a closer and more scenically apt place to invest it than this of Vida Residences as it very much lies in the lap of roughly what UAE, on the whole, is known for globally! As the manifesto behind the creation very aptly explains: ‘In short, it is perfect’, there could genuinely be no fancy way to explain something that is quite self-explanatory due to its very existence and its location itself. However, having said that, the residential tower comprises of 1,2, and 3BR apartments with state-of-the-art infrastructure inspired by ‘New York Art Deco’ architecture of the ’20s.

Instilled with a fresh and unique approach to its interior adornment and furnishing and an astute approach behind its state-of-the-art infrastructure, Genesis is an apt choice of residence for people looking into serenity and style amalgamated with a hint of contemporary urban lifestyle and class. Comprising of a total of 197 apartment units and 10 functional floors, the development features studio,1BR, and 2BR apartments. The houses are embellished with inspiration from the medieval French times and architecture and are designed smartly and strategically to make maximum use of the space. The kitchens are fitted with delicate glass cooking hobs, porcelain floors, and built-in shelves. The residential units are fully equipped with all the modern-day coming-of-age technological facilities like temperature regulators in the kitchen and washroom, dedicated air extraction, and air conditioning systems, fully equipped and guarded mechanical and electrical gauging equipment to ensure the safety of children as well as with electrically controlled driveway and parking systems. In addition to this, the rest of the interior also comprises in-built closets providing the residents with ample storage spaces. Thus, Genesis by Meraki definitely qualifies as a good investment for both families as well as investors.

, Green Diamond one is a beautiful, nature- friendly, ecologically considerate one-of-a-kind residential development. Green Diamond One located in Arjan, Dubai are two commodious residential twin structures both consisting of 8 storeys each. All the houses are fitted with LED lighting to check excessive energy utilization. Offering 2BR and 3BR apartments with easy installment payment plans, Green Diamond One is a definite no-miss!
